changes: OpenClaw shipped two fresh stable releases in one day, v2026.5.5 at 2026-05-06 09:00 UTC and v2026.5.6 at 2026-05-06 17:51 UTC.
HiClaw shipped v1.1.1, published on 2026-05-07 03:33 UTC, which is a real signal that the orchestration lane is still shipping, not just narrating.

Hermes Agent remains canonical under NousResearch/hermes-agent and continues to gain repo momentum, but this run did not surface a new stable release, taxonomy change, or newly validated strategic lane from Hermes itself.
whyItMatters: The strongest signal is still category-anchor velocity: OpenClaw is shipping faster than the rest of the field, and two same-day stable releases reinforce that pace-setting role.
HiClaw shipping again matters because it keeps the multi-agent / control-plane lane alive with fresh product movement, rather than leaving orchestration as a purely conceptual branch.

Net: this was a meaningful but still narrow day. The ecosystem moved, but it did not change the durable strategic map, which still centers on lighter runtimes, safer runtimes, orchestration, learning loops, and cloud digital workers.
